revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: DirectInput receipt bridge: synchronous renderer publication hook records exact ring position before tail publication; synchronous owning-native host import records lifecycle/poll/selected returned record. The hook calls only the guard and never enters guest code. Worker RPC carries caller scene and pointer translation, with actor/instance/window/device generation and deadline fences. No guest callback, EIP/ESP redirection, timer or retained guest continuation is added. Native main and real OS Worker tests cover consumption, nonconsuming PEEK/count, independent release, motion, native COM/acquisition lifetime and refusal controls.
